description: Changes the settings of an automation set up from Cosend’s “Missed call text-back” recipe, named by id, as its settings page in Cosend does: the settings given replace their values, the rest keep theirs, and the result is saved as a new version. If the automation is switched on, the new settings go live with the save, or the save is refused in words and it keeps running what it ran; if it is off, they wait for it to be switched on. An automation from another recipe, or one written by hand, is refused. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the new version.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The automation set up from the “Missed call text-back” recipe whose settings change.

settings.description: The settings to change, as the recipe’s settings form asks them. A setting left out keeps the value it has.

closed_message.description: Sent instead when the call comes outside your opening hours.
closed_message.title: Your message while you are closed

message.description: Sent on WhatsApp to a customer whose call nobody answered.
message.title: Your message while you are open

name: update_missed_call_text_back
title: Change “Missed call text-back” settings
